title: Berlin Street Signs - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **The rule:** every named street must carry a name sign, set out in Berlin's **AV Benennung** (last published **30 October 2026**).
**The look:** black letters on a light panel, in **Berlin's own alphabet**, not the DIN lettering of German road signs.
**The number plate:** the small plate shows the **house numbers on that stretch**. Berlin still mixes **horseshoe** and **odd/even** numbering.
**East and West:** two sign alphabets still hang in the city; older East Berlin signs are replaced over time.
**The plaque:** an optional second plate says **who the street is named after**, in up to three lines.
**Renaming:** the old sign stays up **six months**, struck through in red, under the new one.
**My move:** read the whole sign at your corner once, plate and plaque included.
